# Rekha Krishnamurthy — Makeup & Academy

> Bridal, engagement, non-bridal, party, groom, fashion, editorial and photoshoot makeup artist based in Bangalore, Karnataka, India. Also runs a self-grooming and professional makeup Academy (Launchpad course).

Rekha Krishnamurthy is a professional makeup artist and educator serving Bangalore and Karnataka. The site covers bridal and non-bridal makeup services, an academy offering self-grooming workshops and a professional makeup course, a portfolio of past work, and a blog with wedding and beauty planning advice.

## Services
- [Bridal Makeup](https://rekhakrishnamurthy.com/bridal-makeup-artist-bangalore): HD and Airbrush bridal makeup, hair styling and draping.
- [Engagement Makeup](https://rekhakrishnamurthy.com/engagement-makeup)
- [Non-Bridal Makeup](https://rekhakrishnamurthy.com/non-bridal-makeup): for family and guests.
- [Party Makeup](https://rekhakrishnamurthy.com/party-makeup-artist-bangalore)
- [Groom Makeup](https://rekhakrishnamurthy.com/pre-wedding-photoshoot-makeup-artist)
- [Fashion Makeup](https://rekhakrishnamurthy.com/fashion-makeup)
- [Editorial Makeup](https://rekhakrishnamurthy.com/editorial-makeup)

## Academy
- [Makeup Course & Training](https://rekhakrishnamurthy.com/makeup-course-training-bangalore): the Launchpad professional makeup course.
